summary: Wooden fire tower built 1942 near Prince William Forest Park HQ; moved to Partlow, Spotsylvania County, in 1961, where it is listed as standing. Original site now occupied by a visitor center.

facts.design: Original: wooden tower near the Forest Park headquarters (register). Moved tower at Partlow: 110-foot Aermotor tower with a 7 by 7 foot cab (NHLR)
facts.status_note: The Forest Park tower was moved to Partlow in 1961 and is listed as standing there; the register says a visitor center now occupies the original site

staffing.as_of: after World War II, per 1961 Free-Lance Star item; Partlow tower unstaffed per 2019 visit report

access.note: No source read says whether the public may visit or climb the Partlow tower; a 2019 visit report says the visitor did not approach its base. The original site is inside a national park, but no source describes public access to the tower site itself.

events.note: Register gives build year 1942; description says the tower was apparently erected at the beginning of WWII
Moved to Partlow, Spotsylvania County, in 1961; the 1961 item says it was transferred from Prince William County Forest Park
Erected at Partlow in October 1961 by 13 Virginia Forestry Division staff members per the 1961 item; the NHLR entry gives the build year as 1961 and says 13 locals built it
Partlow Lookout registered January 23, 2017 as US 1163, VA 29; nominated by Kristin Reynolds
Visit report dated August 9, 2019: some rust, missing window glass, cell-tower antenna suite, unstaffed
Added to the Former Fire Lookout Sites register March 25, 2020; nominated by John McDonald

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Partlow register entry says the tower came from Prince William State Forest; the Forest Park register entry and the 1961 item say Prince William Forest Park, which FFLOS lists as administered by the National Park Service. The story uses the Forest Park name and notes the difference.
The Forest Park entry calls the original tower wooden; the Partlow entry calls the moved tower an Aermotor tower. The sources do not say whether the tower was changed when it moved.
The Forest Park entry gives a 1942 build; the Partlow entry gives a 1961 build. The 1961 date matches the re-erection at Partlow reported in the 1961 item, so both dates can describe one tower.

The NHLR entry says 13 locals built the Partlow tower in 1961; the 1961 Free-Lance Star item says 13 Virginia Forestry Division staff members from various locations put it up that week. The story reports both accounts and does not resolve the difference.

notes_for_editor: The Partlow tower is a separate register record (US 1163, VA 29, NHLR) that holds the standing status and visit report; consider linking the two records. The visitor-center claim rests on one register caption credited to the nominator; the NPS contact page does not mention a visitor center, so the story attributes it to the register. The 1961 Free-Lance Star item is read only as quoted on Forest Lookouts, not the original newspaper. The brief's events match the register, so no corrections. The NHLR visit report is from 2019; any change since then is not known.
